title: Co-Branded Card Spend and the Telephone Fee on Crestline Credits
content:
The telephone-fee card-spend rate on a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers counts the co-branded card partner accruals posted to the customer's Summit account in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program in the last 3 calendar months.

**The rule.** The rate is 0.80 for at least 3 such accruals, 0.90 for one or more but fewer than 3, and 1 for none.

**Window.** A telephone-fee window of the last so many calendar months holds the entries dated fewer than that many whole calendar months before the date the telephone fee is booked, so it rolls back from that date and is not a count of completed calendar months.

## Questions on the rule

**Which accruals count?**
Partner accruals posted to the customer's Summit account from the co-branded card partner. Flight accruals and accruals from other partners do not count.

**What does exactly 3 accruals give?**
0.80. The figure of 3 counts as reached.

**How far back does the window reach?**
For a fee booked on 15 October 2026, an accrual posted on 16 July 2026 is 2 whole calendar months back and counts. One posted on 15 July 2026 is 3 whole calendar months back and does not count.

## Count and rate (hypothetical)

| Co-branded card partner accruals in the window | Card-spend rate |
|---|---|
| 4 | 0.80 |
| 3 | 0.80 |
| 2 | 0.90 |
| 1 | 0.90 |
| 0 | 1 |
